svg.text: Tensorflow, Pytorch, Scipy, XGBoost, Python, Matplotlib

text.tspan: AI/ML pipeline built in partnership with Blue Ocean Initiative that forecasts ocean
microplastic concentrations using NASA CYGNSS satellite data. Combines XGBoost time-
series forecasting, a spatiotemporal attention ConvLSTM for spatial prediction, and DBSCAN
clustering to identify pollution hotspots — achieving 0.85+ SSIM and 0.006 MAE on 5-day
Pacific forecasts across 2,490 NASA datasets. Designed to help cleanup organizations plan
more efficient collection routes around Japan.
